notes.note: Mills spent a big portion of the last term on the bench but did have 24 disposals up to that point for his first over 100 in the last three.
Mills was quiet with just the 14 disposals and 5 tackles as his score was well down from what we have seen in recent weeks.
Mills was a popular pick up for Holmes and had the 21 disposals. This was his first under 100 though since round 13.
Mills appeared to get hurt early but played on and posted his best score of the season with his 25 disposals.
Mills has been improving his output each week and was one of just two Swans in the 100 club this week.
